name: georest
summary: Python clients for public geospatial REST APIs: ArcGIS Image, Map and Feature Services and Portal search; the USFS Enterprise Data Warehouse, FIA estimates and LCMS summaries; USGS water, river network, elevation, earthquake, ScienceBase and water-quality services; FEMA flood maps and disaster declarations; and NOAA weather, river, tide and hurricane services.
author: Ryan Rock, Ian Housman
